grounding.from: Distress Centres of Greater Toronto offer free 24/7 support for people in crisis or emotional distress by hotline, online chat and text.

value.answer: Sorry, finding the right person can be a slog, and it's a good thing you're looking. Some free or cheap options in Toronto: Family Service Toronto does counselling with sliding-scale fees based on income. The Ontario Structured Psychotherapy program offers free short-term CBT for adults with depression or anxiety. The U of T and TMU training clinics see clients at reduced rates, with supervised students. Your employer's EAP may cover a few free sessions a year, and extended health plans often cover private therapists. For a private therapist, Psychotherapy Referral Service can connect you with registered psychotherapists. If it gets urgent, ConnexOntario is free and open 24 hours at 1-866-531-2600, and Distress Centres of Greater Toronto runs a free 24/7 hotline, chat and text.
